pkgmetadata.longdescription:
MMM (Monitoring and Maintenance Manager) is NEC's proprietary host-side management agent for SX-Aurora TSUBASA Vector Engine cards. This package installs the vecmd command, used to query card status (vecmd state get) and hardware information (vecmd info), together with the ve_monitor daemon it queries. Card management requires MMM firmware on the VE and a valid MMM license.
Built from the RHEL 8 vendor package rather than the RHEL 10 one: the EL10 binaries carry GNU_PROPERTY_X86_ISA_1_NEEDED for x86-64-v3 and are refused by the loader on pre-AVX2 CPUs, while the EL8 build has no ISA requirement. It therefore links against libcrypto.so.1.1 (dev-libs/openssl-compat:1.1) instead of libcrypto.so.3.
